title: Magic Knight Rayearth
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On a school trip to Tokyo Tower, three girls from different schools, Hikaru, Umi and Fuu, are pulled into Cephiro, a world shaped by will, where they are summoned to become the legendary Magic Knights. Guided by Guru Clef, they learn magic, gain weapons and giant guardian beings, and set out to rescue Princess Emeraude from High Priest Zagato. A three-volume CLAMP shoujo fantasy (first part of the saga).
life_message: Friendship and a strong will can carry ordinary girls through a heavy duty.
